Generate roxygen2 documentation for a dataset with a language model

Source: R/roxygen.R
sd_generate_roxygen.Rd

The automated version of "03_generoi_roxygen.R": takes the labels, value labels and paradata already attached to an sd_data object (see sd_read(), or set manually) and asks a language model to write a complete roxygen2 documentation block for it, ready to save as R/<object_name>.R next to a dataset saved with usethis::use_data().

Usage

sd_generate_roxygen(
  x,
  object_name,
  model = "gemma3:12b",
  backend = "ollama",
  instructions = NULL,
  dry_run = TRUE,
  file = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  timeout_s = 1200,
  language = "fi",
  store = NULL,
  top_k = 2
)

Arguments

x

An sd_data object. Labels and value labels (see sd_read()'s automatic haven-label import, or set them directly on x$meta$labels/x$meta$value_labels) make for a much better result — a dataset with no labels at all still works, but the model will have only variable names and value ranges to go on.

object_name

Name the documented object will have once saved with usethis::use_data(), e.g. "survey_data". Required — this is what the generated documentation is attached to.

model, backend, timeout_s

As in sd_document().

instructions

Passed on to sd_build_roxygen_prompt().

dry_run

If TRUE (the default), the result is only returned, not written to disk. Set to FALSE to write it to file.

file

Path to write the documentation to when dry_run = FALSE. Defaults to file.path("R", paste0(object_name, ".R")), matching where usethis::use_data() expects a dataset's documentation.

overwrite

If FALSE (the default) and file already exists, sd_generate_roxygen() refuses to overwrite it and raises an error instead — set TRUE once you've checked the existing file.

language

Language the generated roxygen2 documentation should be written in – one of "fi" (Finnish, the default), "en" (English) or "sv" (Swedish). Only affects the built-in instructions (and small field labels in the dataset-information block); has no effect when instructions is supplied explicitly. See sd_build_roxygen_prompt().

store

Optional connected ragnar RagnarStore (see ragnar::ragnar_store_connect()) built from your own reference material. When given, sd_retrieve_context() looks up background material for each variable and inserts it into the prompt. NULL (the default) skips retrieval entirely – behaves exactly as before this parameter was added.

top_k

Number of chunks retrieved per variable when store is given. Passed on to sd_retrieve_context().

Value

An object of class sd_roxygen with elements text (the generated roxygen2 block), prompt, object_name, model, backend, file (the path written to, or NULL when dry_run = TRUE), chat (the underlying ellmer chat object), and created.

Details

By default (dry_run = TRUE) nothing is written to disk — the generated text is only returned (and can be inspected with print()/cat()) so you can check it before committing to a file. Set dry_run = FALSE to write it out; an existing file is never silently overwritten unless overwrite = TRUE.

Requirements

Same as sd_document() — a running Ollama installation with model pulled. Run sd_check_ollama() first. A response can take from seconds to minutes; sd_generate_roxygen() prints a message before sending the request so a long wait doesn't look frozen.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
aineisto <- sd_read("survey_data.sav")
tulos <- sd_generate_roxygen(aineisto, "survey_data")
print(tulos)

# Kun teksti näyttää hyvältä, kirjoita tiedostoon:
tulos <- sd_generate_roxygen(aineisto, "survey_data", dry_run = FALSE)
} # }
